ball.lore.rare: Always bounces towards the most breakable thing in sight, even if it has to go round a corner to find it.
ball.lore.epic: Went over next door's fence so often that the grandad there kept it and started a team. They are top of the league.
ball.lore.legendary: Was kicked so high at a school match that it came down a week later, covered in frost, with a seagull still sitting on it.

x_bouncy_ball.lore.rare: Bounces a little higher every time it lands, so a ball dropped at breakfast is still being chased at lunch.
x_bouncy_ball.lore.epic: Ricocheted round the kitchen for ten minutes and knocked every fridge magnet into alphabetical order.

x_magic_8_ball.lore.rare: Reads the question on your face before you ask it, then answers 'not telling' just to watch you squirm.
x_magic_8_ball.lore.epic: Said no to every single question at a sleepover, so a whole room of children stayed up until dawn trying to get one yes.

x_marble.lore.rare: Rolls uphill whenever anyone tries to tidy it away, and it always reaches the top of the stairs first.
x_marble.lore.epic: Escaped the marble run during assembly, and the head teacher slid all the way to the stage on it, still talking.
x_marble.lore.legendary: Was flicked so hard in the playground that it went all the way round the world and hit its owner's other marble from behind.

x_stress_ball.lore.uncommon: Takes a little longer to puff back up every day, as if it is sulking about being squeezed.
x_stress_ball.lore.rare: Soaks up the grumpiness of whoever squeezes it, then grumbles about it all night in the drawer.
x_stress_ball.lore.epic: Absorbed a whole office's stress on deadline day, swelled to the size of a sofa and had to be rolled out of the fire door.
x_stress_ball.lore.legendary: Took the stress of a whole country on one terrible Monday, went flat as a pancake, and Tuesday was lovely for everybody.

balloon.lore.rare: Rubs itself on jumpers to build up static, then zaps the birthday child right on the nose.
balloon.lore.epic: Was tied to the shopping trolley and lifted it off the car park, so Mum had to walk it home like a kite.
balloon.lore.legendary: Floated all the way round the world and drifted back in through the same window a year later, just in time for cake.

x_confetti.lore.rare: Doubles when swept, so every dustpan comes back with more confetti than the floor had.
x_confetti.lore.epic: Went off a week early inside a birthday card, and the post office is still sparkling at Easter.
x_confetti.lore.legendary: Was thrown so high at one wedding that it is still coming down, and the couple's grandchildren keep finding bits in their hair.

baseball_bat.lore.rare: Makes every ball it hits buzz like a wasp, so the fielders run away instead of trying to catch it.
baseball_bat.lore.epic: Smashed a ball over the park fence into the duck pond, and the ducks have been using it as a football ever since.

basketball.lore.rare: Swerves away from the hoop at the last second whenever its owner's friends are watching.
basketball.lore.epic: Was slam-dunked so hard that it went through the court floor and came up in the school kitchen, inside the custard.
basketball.lore.legendary: Went in from so far away that the scoreboard ran out of numbers and gave the point to the ball.

x_coloring_book.lore.rare: Colours in its own pages overnight, always in the wrong colours: purple grass, green faces and a tartan sky.
x_coloring_book.lore.epic: Leaked its outlines onto the kitchen table, so the family now eats dinner off a colouring-in of a farm.
x_coloring_book.lore.legendary: Its unfinished drawings stepped off the page one rainy day, and a half-coloured giraffe ate the curtains.

x_baby_bottle.lore.rare: Warms itself to exactly the right temperature, but only once everyone in the house is awake.
x_baby_bottle.lore.epic: Squirted milk across the kitchen in one long arc and filled the cat's bowl from the high chair.
x_baby_bottle.lore.legendary: Got a baby to sleep so well that she slept through her own first birthday party, and the guests ate the cake in whispers.

x_sports_bottle.lore.rare: Squirts sideways whenever anyone but its owner drinks from it, so nobody else has ever had a sip.
x_sports_bottle.lore.legendary: Was squeezed so hard on the hottest sports day ever that it watered the whole pitch, and the grass came up green by the final whistle.

x_crayon_box.lore.rare: Swaps the paper wrappers at night, so the crayon labelled blue always draws orange.
x_crayon_box.lore.epic: Was left with a toddler for five minutes, and the dog came out of the bedroom striped like a tiger.

x_jack_in_the_box.lore.rare: Pops out at the worst possible moment, always mid-sip or mid-sneeze, and never when it has just been wound.
x_jack_in_the_box.lore.epic: Popped out so high at a birthday party that it stuck in the ceiling light and nodded at the guests all evening.
x_jack_in_the_box.lore.legendary: Popped out once with such a spring that it bounced to the top of the town clock, and now jumps out every hour on the hour.

x_music_box_toy.lore.rare: Speeds up its tune whenever someone dances to it, until the little dancer on top is spinning like a top.
x_music_box_toy.lore.epic: Was wound up in a busy shop, and the whole queue slowed down and waltzed to the till.
x_music_box_toy.lore.legendary: Played its tune so beautifully that the tiny dancer climbed out of the lid and joined a real ballet company.

x_sand_bucket.lore.epic: Filled itself with the tide and carried half the sea back to the car, and the boot is still sloshing.
x_sand_bucket.lore.legendary: Built a sandcastle so tall that the tide came in, took one look at it and went back out again.

i_pinwheel.lore.rare: Spins fast enough to blow out birthday candles from across the room, which is very unfair on the birthday child.
i_pinwheel.lore.epic: Spun so hard in a gale that it lifted off the sandcastle and flew like a helicopter into the ice cream van.
i_pinwheel.lore.legendary: Spun so fast during a storm that it blew the clouds away, and the beach had sunshine for a fortnight.

game_controller.lore.rare: Presses buttons by itself whenever its owner is winning, and it always picks the one that pauses the game.
game_controller.lore.legendary: Found a secret level so deep in a game that the people who made it phoned up to ask how to get out.

handheld_console.lore.rare: Pauses the world whenever its owner pauses the game, so the whole table is frozen mid-chew.
handheld_console.lore.epic: Was played so quietly on a ten-hour drive that the parents forgot the children were there and sang the whole way.
handheld_console.lore.legendary: Was played on the longest car journey ever and finished every game ever made, so it started making its own.

x_sweatband.lore.rare: Squeezes all its sweat back out at the worst moment, straight onto the hand shaking the winner's.
x_sweatband.lore.epic: Got so full on the hottest day that it rained on the umpire, and the match was stopped for bad weather.
x_sweatband.lore.legendary: Was wrung out after one long final into the club pond, and the ducks there now play in headbands.

x_pinata.lore.rare: Refills itself every time it is hung back up, but always with sprouts instead of sweets.
x_pinata.lore.epic: Burst so hard at a birthday party that next door's guttering is still full of lollipops.
x_pinata.lore.legendary: Was finally burst by the whole school, and inside was a smaller pinata, then a smaller one, all the way down to one sweet.

x_rocking_toy.lore.rare: Rocks itself when nobody is watching, and every morning it is a little closer to the biscuit tin.
x_rocking_toy.lore.epic: Rocked so hard at playgroup that the whole floor rocked with it, and the goldfish was seasick.
x_rocking_toy.lore.legendary: Was rocked so hard for so long that the house now rocks with it, and the family has to hold on to their tea.

i_mask.lore.epic: Was worn on school photo day, so the class picture has one row of very polite tigers.

x_play_dough.lore.rare: Comes alive at night as whatever it was last shaped into, and the dough dinosaur keeps eating the dough sandwiches.
x_play_dough.lore.epic: Was rolled into one giant ball and rolled down the hall, collecting two shoes, a recorder and the head teacher's keys.
x_play_dough.lore.legendary: Was shaped into a model of the town so perfect that the postman started delivering letters to it.

kite.lore.rare: Drags its flyer along the beach by the heels and will not stop until it reaches the ice cream van.
kite.lore.epic: Caught such a gust that it lifted a towel, a sandwich and somebody's sun hat into the sky on the same string.
kite.lore.legendary: Flew so high that a flock of geese started following it south, and now it can't land because it's the leader.

x_toy_dinosaur.lore.rare: Grows a little every time it is left in the bath, and now nobody can find a bath big enough for it.
x_toy_dinosaur.lore.legendary: Was buried in the sandpit so long that a museum dug it up and put it next to its very surprised great-great-grandad.

x_toy_kitchen.lore.uncommon: Has an oven door that slams so hard that the plastic chicken jumps out of the tray.
x_toy_kitchen.lore.rare: Makes pretend food smell real, so the whole house wakes up hungry for plastic sausages.
x_toy_kitchen.lore.epic: Opened a restaurant in the playroom and got a bad review from the cat, who sent the soup back twice.
x_toy_kitchen.lore.legendary: Cooked pretend dinners so well that the family's real oven handed in its notice.

piggy_bank.lore.rare: Gets heavier every time someone thinks about spending, so nobody can lift it before the summer holidays.
piggy_bank.lore.epic: Was shaken upside down at a birthday party and coughed out a button, a bus ticket and a very old sweet.
piggy_bank.lore.legendary: Saved so many coins that it bought the bank on the high street, and now the cashiers have to oink.

ping_pong_table.lore.epic: Hosted a garage rally so long that the car moved out and parked on the street in protest.

x_building_blocks.lore.rare: Rebuilds itself into a wall across the doorway overnight, so nobody can get to the toy box.
x_building_blocks.lore.epic: Toppled from a tower as tall as the fridge and landed spelling NO on the floor.
x_building_blocks.lore.legendary: Was stacked so high that the top block sticks out of the chimney, and the birds use it as a lookout.

x_checkers.lore.rare: Crowns itself king whenever nobody is looking, then moves backwards with a smug little click.
x_checkers.lore.epic: Was played so slowly in the park that pigeons nested on the board and had to be counted as pieces.
x_checkers.lore.legendary: Jumped every piece on the board in one move, then off the table, and won the game next door as well.

x_chess_board.lore.rare: Shuffles one piece a square whenever the players blink, then insists it was always there.

x_dice.lore.rare: Always rolls exactly the number that lands its player on the longest snake.
x_dice.lore.epic: Rolled off the board, under the fridge and into next door's game, where it won them the whole thing.
x_dice.lore.legendary: Rolled a seven on its very first throw, and nobody has been able to find the seventh side since.

x_domino.lore.rare: Knocks over anything standing in a row: books, bottles and every plant pot on the windowsill.
x_domino.lore.epic: Set off a run so long that the last one flicked the kettle switch, and the tea was ready on time.
x_domino.lore.legendary: Started a run that went round the whole town and finished by knocking on its own front door.

puzzle.lore.rare: Changes two pieces' shapes overnight, so the last piece never fits the last gap.
puzzle.lore.epic: Was spread over the dining table for a whole week, so the family had Sunday dinner on the stairs.

x_lego_brick.lore.legendary: Clicked itself onto the bottom of the house one night, and now the whole house can be rebuilt as a boat.

x_rubik_cube.lore.rare: Twists one row back every time someone puts it down, so it is never quite solved.
x_rubik_cube.lore.epic: Got so mixed up that its colours slid onto the school uniform, and the whole class came home checked.
x_rubik_cube.lore.legendary: Was solved so fast that it went back in time and was never mixed up in the first place.

racket.lore.rare: Hums a high note whenever it hits the sweet spot, and every dog in the next street howls back.
racket.lore.legendary: Hit a ball so high in a summer match that it came down in the winter, and the umpire called it out.

robot_toy.lore.rare: Copies whatever the nearest grown-up is doing, so it has started doing the ironing, badly.
robot_toy.lore.epic: Tidied the whole bedroom in the night, putting every toy in the bin and the bin in the wardrobe.
robot_toy.lore.legendary: Learned to talk, then learned to argue, and has now won every argument with the kitchen radio.

x_toy_robot_dog.lore.rare: Barks at the doorbell a second before it rings, and somehow it is always right.
x_toy_robot_dog.lore.epic: Was taken for a real walk and chased a real squirrel up a tree, and is now stuck on the bottom branch, beeping.
x_toy_robot_dog.lore.legendary: Fooled the cat so completely that the cat now takes it for a walk every morning on a lead.

x_wind_up_toy.lore.rare: Winds itself up at night and marches into the kitchen, where it is found every morning in the butter.
x_wind_up_toy.lore.epic: Was wound up one turn too far and walked out of the front door, down the road and onto the bus.

x_toy_boat.lore.rare: Makes its own tiny waves in the bath that soak everyone in the room except the child in it.
x_toy_boat.lore.epic: Won the pond race by giving a duck a lift, and now the duck expects one every Sunday.
x_toy_boat.lore.legendary: Sailed out of the bath, down the plughole and across the sea, and sent home a postcard from a beach.

skateboard.lore.rare: Rolls itself back to the top of the hill every night, so its rider's day always starts with a downhill.
skateboard.lore.epic: Rolled downhill through the market and came out the other end carrying a melon, a hat and somebody's sandwich.
skateboard.lore.legendary: Did an ollie so high that it landed on top of the town hall and has been the weather vane ever since.

x_flippers.lore.rare: Makes its wearer swim so fast that they keep overtaking the lifeguard, who is not pleased about it.
x_flippers.lore.epic: Kicked up so much sand on holiday that the bay stayed cloudy for a week and the fish had to wear goggles.

soccer_ball.lore.epic: Was booted so hard that it knocked the crossbar off, and the match finished with a washing line instead.
soccer_ball.lore.legendary: Was kicked so hard that it went round the world and back into the same net, and the referee gave it two goals.

x_elbow_pads.lore.rare: Bounces its wearer back up off the ground like a rubber ball, which is great until there's a pond nearby.
x_elbow_pads.lore.epic: Was so padded that its owner tripped in the playground, rolled the full length of it and reached the dinner queue first.
x_elbow_pads.lore.legendary: Took a fall so hard that the playground got the bruise, and it still has a soft patch in the shape of an elbow.

x_knee_pads.lore.rare: Turns every kneel into a long, smooth knee slide, right across the kitchen and into the bin.
x_knee_pads.lore.epic: Slid its wearer across a whole wedding dance floor on their knees, all the way under the cake table.
x_knee_pads.lore.legendary: Took a fall so hard that the pavement now has two knee-shaped dents, and the town has put a sign up.

x_shin_guard.lore.rare: Clangs like a bell whenever it is kicked, so every tackle sounds like the end of a boxing round.
x_shin_guard.lore.epic: Got kicked so hard that the striker's boot bounced off and the ball went in at the other end.
x_shin_guard.lore.legendary: Was kicked by a cow during a match in a field, and it was the cow that said sorry.

x_tea_set_toy.lore.epic: Hosted a teddy tea party so posh that the teddies now refuse to sit with the plastic dinosaurs.
x_tea_set_toy.lore.legendary: Held a tea party so polite that every teddy stood up when Grandma came in, and one of them bowed.

tennis_ball.lore.rare: Sticks to any dog's mouth like glue, so a game of fetch never actually ends.
tennis_ball.lore.epic: Was thrown at the dog park and brought back by a goose, a seal and a very confused jogger.

x_chess_piece.lore.rare: Knocks over the other king with a tiny wobble, then pretends it was the wind.
x_chess_piece.lore.epic: Was sucked up by the vacuum cleaner mid-game, and the game was finished with a salt shaker as queen.
x_chess_piece.lore.legendary: Was promoted so many times that it became a queen, then a king, then president of the chess club.

x_party_horn.lore.rare: Unrolls further every time it is blown, until it can tap someone on the shoulder from across the room.
x_party_horn.lore.epic: Was blown in the library by mistake, and the librarian had to go and lie down.
x_party_horn.lore.legendary: Tooted so loudly at one birthday that it woke every hibernating hedgehog in the county, and they all wanted cake.

x_baby_doll.lore.rare: Cries whenever anyone else gets a cuddle, and it has never needed batteries to do it.
x_baby_doll.lore.epic: Was dressed by every child at playgroup in turn, and came home wearing nine hats and one shoe.

x_ball_pit_ball.lore.rare: Multiplies at night, so the ball pit is always a little fuller in the morning than when it closed.
x_ball_pit_ball.lore.epic: Left the soft play in every child's pocket, and the car park now has a ball pit of its own.
x_ball_pit_ball.lore.legendary: Rolled out of the soft play, across town and into the football final, where it was used for the second half.

x_barbie_doll.lore.rare: Borrows its owner's real socks to wear as capes, so every morning somebody is missing one.
x_barbie_doll.lore.epic: Held a fashion show on the dining table during dinner, and Dad's peas were moved to the front row.

x_basketball_hoop.lore.rare: Wobbles its rim at the last second, so every easy shot spins out and every silly one goes in.
x_basketball_hoop.lore.epic: Was slam-dunked so hard that it now hangs at toddler height, and the toddler is unbeatable.
x_basketball_hoop.lore.legendary: Caught every shot one summer, even the ones aimed at the bin, and the bin went on strike.

x_boomerang.lore.uncommon: Comes back with other people's things: a sun hat, half a sandwich and once a very surprised kite.
x_boomerang.lore.rare: Comes back to its thrower wherever they go, even if they have gone home and are in the bath.

x_bowling_ball.lore.rare: Curves into the next lane at the last second and knocks down somebody else's pins.
x_bowling_ball.lore.epic: Rolled so slowly at a birthday party that everyone had cake and came back before it reached the pins.
x_bowling_ball.lore.legendary: Bowled a strike so perfect that the pins stood back up just to fall over again for the photo.

x_bubble_wand.lore.rare: Blows bubbles that bounce instead of popping, and one has been bouncing round the kitchen since Tuesday.
x_bubble_wand.lore.epic: Blew a bubble round the garden gnome, which floated over three gardens and landed in a paddling pool.
x_bubble_wand.lore.legendary: Blew a bubble so big that the whole house floated inside it to the seaside and popped just in time for chips.

x_dodgeball.lore.common: Always finds the one person who isn't playing, usually the teacher with a cup of tea.
x_dodgeball.lore.epic: Was thrown so hard that it bounced round the gym for a whole lesson, and the class went to lunch while it was still going.
x_dodgeball.lore.legendary: Was dodged so well by one boy that it gave up, sat down on the bench and asked to be a beach ball.

x_doll_house.lore.rare: Rearranges its tiny furniture every night, so the dolls are always having breakfast in the bath.
x_doll_house.lore.epic: Sprang a tiny leak in its tiny roof, and the dolls held a very serious meeting about tiny buckets.
x_doll_house.lore.legendary: Grows a tiny new room every year, and is now bigger than the real house, so the family lives in the attic.

x_exercise_ball.lore.epic: Was sat on during a video call and bounced its owner out of the picture every ten seconds, so the meeting blamed the internet.

x_handball.lore.rare: Sticks to the hand of whoever throws it, so the goalkeeper catches the ball and the thrower too.
x_handball.lore.epic: Was thrown so hard in the final that it took the goalkeeper's gloves with it into the net.
x_handball.lore.legendary: Was passed so fast round the team that it came back to the first player before she had let go.

x_kaleidoscope.lore.epic: Got stuck on one pattern and beamed it onto the bedroom ceiling, and the family now sleeps under a giant paper snowflake.
x_kaleidoscope.lore.legendary: Was twisted so many times that it ran out of patterns, so now it shows next week's weather instead.

x_lego_figure.lore.rare: Walks off the shelf at night and is found the next morning at the bottom of the cereal box.
x_lego_figure.lore.epic: Lined up every toy in the box outside the bathroom one morning, and the real family had to queue behind them.
x_lego_figure.lore.legendary: Was lost down the back of the sofa so long that it built a little town in there, with a post office.

x_marionette.lore.rare: Pulls its puppeteer around by the strings when it gets excited, so the show ends in a different room.
x_marionette.lore.epic: Tangled the whole puppet theatre into one big knot mid-show, and the audience cheered for the knot.

x_medicine_ball.lore.epic: Was dropped in the gym so hard that the basketballs in the cupboard bounced for an hour.
x_medicine_ball.lore.legendary: Was only ever lifted by the caretaker, who has been able to open every jam jar in town since.

x_mouthguard.lore.rare: Turns every word its wearer says into a sneeze, so the referee keeps saying bless you.
x_mouthguard.lore.epic: Was boiled to fit so perfectly that it now whistles the team song whenever its owner breathes.
x_mouthguard.lore.legendary: Was so tough that a shark bit it on holiday and swam off with a sore tooth.

x_pacifier.lore.rare: Gets spat out so hard that it lands in the next room, usually in somebody's cup of tea.
x_pacifier.lore.legendary: Calmed a baby so well that she slept through a thunderstorm, a brass band and Grandad's sneeze.

x_pool_float.lore.epic: Was blown up so big for a pool party that it pushed all the water out, and next door's lawn is now a paddling pool.
x_pool_float.lore.legendary: Was blown up with so much air that it floated over the hedge, and is now a very small cloud.

x_puppet.lore.rare: Says out loud whatever its owner is too polite to say, and somehow everyone blames the sock.
x_puppet.lore.epic: Told the head teacher in assembly that her shoes were on the wrong feet, and they were.
x_puppet.lore.legendary: Told a joke so funny that the statue in the park laughed and dropped its umbrella.

x_rattle.lore.rare: Rattles louder the closer anyone in the house gets to a nap, and loudest of all for Grandad.
x_rattle.lore.epic: Was shaken so hard on the bus that the driver thought it was hail and turned on the wipers.
x_rattle.lore.legendary: Rattled so loudly that it set off every car alarm in the street, which made the baby laugh even harder.

x_shot_put.lore.legendary: Was thrown so far at sports day that it landed in next year's sports day, and won that too.

x_shuttlecock.lore.epic: Flew into the sports hall vent and came out of the fan in the head teacher's office.
x_shuttlecock.lore.legendary: Was hit so high that a passing goose took it home to show the family, and they have been playing ever since.

x_slinky.lore.rare: Walks up the stairs as well as down, usually in the middle of the night, very loudly.
x_slinky.lore.epic: Stretched from the top floor to the front door and caught the post on its way in.
x_slinky.lore.legendary: Walked down the stairs, out of the door and down a mountain, and reached the seaside a week later.

x_softball.lore.rare: Goes soft whenever anyone tries to hit it and hard whenever anyone tries to catch it.
x_softball.lore.epic: Was hit into a pond, and a frog caught it and threw it to second base.
x_softball.lore.legendary: Was hit so far that it landed in another time zone, and the batter had to fly there to touch home.

x_starting_block.lore.rare: Fires its runner off before the starting gun, then acts as if nothing happened.
x_starting_block.lore.epic: Launched a sprinter so hard that she finished the race before the crowd had sat down.
x_starting_block.lore.legendary: Launched a runner so fast that she got home before she had set off, and had tea waiting for herself.

x_sticker.lore.rare: Moves itself to the best spot on the sticker chart overnight, so one child always seems to be winning.
x_sticker.lore.legendary: Stuck so well that it held a fence together through a storm, and the town now asks it to look after the bridge.

x_swim_ring.lore.rare: Floats its rider in slow circles towards the ice cream kiosk, whichever way they paddle.
x_swim_ring.lore.epic: Was blown up so tight that its rider skipped across the pool like a stone and landed in the paddling pool.
x_swim_ring.lore.legendary: Floated so well that a lost baby whale used it to get home, and still sends a postcard every summer.

x_teether.lore.rare: Stays freezing cold for a week after one night in the fridge, and gives brain freeze to anyone who touches it.
x_teether.lore.legendary: Was chewed so bravely through one teething night that the baby woke up with all its teeth at once, grinning.

x_toy_soldier.lore.rare: Salutes whenever a grown-up walks in, then marches off with one of their biscuits.
x_toy_soldier.lore.epic: Marched the whole box across the bedroom in the night and was found at dawn guarding the fridge.
x_toy_soldier.lore.legendary: Stood guard so bravely that the fox who raids the bins saluted it and moved to another street.

x_ventriloquist_dummy.lore.rare: Talks back when its owner's mouth is shut, usually to say what everyone was thinking.
x_ventriloquist_dummy.lore.epic: Answered the phone in its owner's voice and booked the whole family a holiday at the wrong seaside.
x_ventriloquist_dummy.lore.legendary: Told a joke so good that its owner laughed with his mouth wide open, and nobody could tell which one was the dummy.
